_: Walk progression test motion — readable spec. The authoritative bytes are in walk-progression-v1.bin (generated by scripts/research/generate_walk_test_motion.py). This JSON shows joint deltas from stock walkready so a reviewer can verify magnitudes by hand.

units.invalid: 0x4000 (16384) marks joint as not driven by this page

walkready_base_pose_ticks._note: R_SHOULDER_PITCH = 0x4000 (INVALID) — owned by Walking module, not driven by Action pages

common_safety.exit_meaning: Stop() → page 15 (sit_down). Pressing Ctrl+C during action_editor playback will safely sit the robot down.

pages.name: wk_hold
pages.purpose: Hold walkready for 2 s. Verifies servo command + pose stability before any motion. Lowest risk page in this suite.

pages.name: wk_arms
pages.purpose: Arms-only motion. Legs untouched. Verifies servo command path on non-leg joints. Safe even off cradle.

steps.note: Left shoulder pitch -10°, both elbows bend ~15°. R_SHOULDER_PITCH untouched (INVALID in walkready).

pages.name: wk_knee
pages.purpose: Gentle squat (3°). Verifies leg servo command under load + coordinated hip_pitch / knee / ankle_pitch.

steps.note: Coordinated squat — torso stays vertical. Knee bend = 3°, hip/ankle compensate 1.5° each.

pages.name: wk_hip_r
pages.purpose: Body sway to right via hip_roll only (no ankle change, feet stay planted). Tests lateral CoM transfer prior to single-foot support.

steps.note: Both hips roll +2.5° → torso shifts right while feet stay planted.

pages.name: wk_hip_l
pages.purpose: Mirror of wk_hip_r. Body sway to left.

steps.note: Both hips roll -2.5° → torso shifts left.

pages.name: wk_lean_pitch
pages.purpose: Forward + backward pitch sway (2° each direction). Tests pitch-axis balance feedback. Same pose pattern as NimbRo patch 12 'lean_fb_gain' acts on.

next_steps_after_pages_pass: Capture per-page IMU pitch/roll trace via NimbRo patch-18 style UDP publisher (Sprint 11).
Cross-reference observed IMU oscillation amplitude with Walking::balance_angle_smooth_gain LPF (NimbRo patch 12) before tuning Sprint 5 walk-engine.
If wk_lean_pitch shows >10° pitch drift, lower foot_height or increase ankle_pitch_offset in walk-engine config.
Only after pages 110..115 all pass cleanly: enable forge-cli walk-engine 'slowWalk' preset on cradle.
